title: Skin Care for Varanasi Weather: A Routine for Loo Summers, Humid Monsoons and Foggy Winters
ex: Hot loo winds, long days on the ghats, a sticky monsoon and cold foggy winters: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Varanasi.
rt: Skin Care for Varanasi Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Varanasi weather: sun care for hot loo summers and ghat days, light layers in the humid monsoon and a richer routine for cold, foggy winters.
quick: Varanasi has a very hot, dry summer with loo winds from about April to June, a humid monsoon to September and a cold, foggy winter from December to February. Keep a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, go lighter in the hot and wet months, and use a richer night cream and lip balm in winter.
facts: Varanasi is on the Ganga in eastern Uttar Pradesh, far from the sea
April to June brings very hot days and dry loo winds
The monsoon runs roughly late June to September
December and January bring dense fog and cold-wave spells
